clue.text: He retired without painting our present abode

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one piece wraps the other
retired means withdrew, went back, so the word He is turned round

parts.note: taken as written
painting is a form of art

explanation.surface: A man has gone into retirement and given up his painting hobby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking; 'retired' signals the turnaround.
explanation.definitionFit: The planet is the place where humanity currently lives, our home world.

clue.text: Discomfit bishop over tapestry in German town

indicators.note: in places the bishop and tapestry inside the town

parts.note: Bad Ems is a spa town in Germany, Ems

indicators.note: in a down clue over means placed above, so this comes first

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
an arras is a wall tapestry

explanation.surface: A churchman is embarrassed by a hanging in a German town.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'over' puts the bishop above the tapestry; 'in' sets both inside the spa town.
explanation.definitionFit: To discomfit is to make uneasy, which is what causing shame or awkwardness does.

clue.text: Publish sources of its contents, using mysterious symbols

parts.note: to run a story is to publish it

indicators.note: sources are origins, so the first letter of each word is taken

explanation.surface: A publisher reveals where the material came from, written in code.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sources of' takes the first letters I and C.
explanation.definitionFit: Runic means written in runes, the ancient letters thought to have magical meaning.

clue.text: Former intellect ate pastry dish outside Eastern church

indicators.note: outside means going round, so one piece wraps the next

parts.note: had means ate, as in had dinner
a pie is a pastry dish
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A one-time thinker ate a pie outside an eastern church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts HAD round E.
explanation.definitionFit: Headpiece is an old word for the brain or intellect, now out of use.

clue.text: It's collected and held as property

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both calm and composed, and owned or kept as one's own.

clue.text: The case for land tax in' Scotland

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
cess was a land tax in Scotland

explanation.surface: An argument supporting a land tax in Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: Cess is an old Scottish word for a tax on land.
explanation.definitionFit: In law a process is a lawsuit or the formal action of a court case.

clue.text: European press chief in smart surroundings

indicators.note: in places the editor within the other piece
surroundings means the smart word is wrapped around the other

parts.note: swish means smart, fashionable
ED is an editor, the chief of a newspaper

explanation.surface: A continental newspaper boss works in elegant surroundings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in smart surroundings' means one piece sits within the smart word.
explanation.definitionFit: Swedish describes a person from Sweden, a nation of Europe.

clue.text: Result: guarantee runs out

indicators.note: out means removed, so the letter is taken from the word

parts.note: to ensure is to guarantee
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: The outcome: a warranty has expired.
explanation.walkthrough: R is taken out of ENSURE.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensue is to follow as a consequence, to result.

clue.text: Milk supplier's neat cape

parts.note: a neat drink is a short, served without a mixer
Cape Horn is the southern tip of South America, a horn

explanation.surface: A dairy firm's tidy coastal headland.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a short is a small strong drink, served neat.
explanation.definitionFit: The shorthorn is a breed of cattle, used for dairy, so it supplies milk.

clue.text: Fine fellow supporting daughter

indicators.note: in a down clue supporting means placed below, holding up the other piece

parts.note: Andy is a man's name, any fellow

explanation.surface: A fine man stands behind his daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fine fellow' looks like the definition (a dandy is a smart man), but the definition is just 'Fine'.
explanation.definitionFit: Dandy is informal for excellent or very good, as in fine and dandy.

clue.text: Girl soldiers involved in trial here in India

indicators.note: involved in means wrapped up inside, so these pieces sit within another

parts.note: a trial is an affliction or nuisance, a bane
gal is an informal word for a girl
OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A young woman and some troops are caught up in a court case in India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trial' looks legal but means an affliction; 'involved in' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Bangalore is a major city in southern India, so it is a place there.

clue.text: Mark finally changes direction, giving rise to contempt

indicators.note: the last letter is a compass point, and it swaps for a different compass point

parts.note: a mark in a test is a score

explanation.surface: A student's grade alters at the last moment and causes disdain.
explanation.walkthrough: SCORE ends in E (east); 'finally changes direction' swaps it for N (north).
explanation.definitionFit: Scorn is a feeling of disdain, a synonym of contempt.

clue.text: Duke leaves MP to sum up

indicators.note: leaves means goes away from, so a letter is taken out of the other word

parts.note: a redcap is a member of the British military police, MP

explanation.surface: A nobleman walks out on a member of parliament, to sum things up.
explanation.walkthrough: MP here is military police (REDCAP), not a member of parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: To recap is to summarise briefly what has been said.

clue.text: This compiler's books seen in the City to a notable extent

indicators.note: seen in means found inside, so these letters go within the city

parts.note: Ely is a small cathedral city in Cambridgeshire
the setter's own, i.e. mine
NT is the New Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: The setter's books turn up in the City of London to a remarkable degree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the City' tempts as the City of London; it is ELY, a cathedral city in eastern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Eminently means remarkably or highly, to a degree that stands out.

clue.text: Short of members to equip? Not so

parts.note: to arm troops is to equip them with weapons
less means not so much, to a smaller degree

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a club lacks members to kit out, and is told no.
explanation.definitionFit: Members here are limbs, so lacking arms means without those limbs.

clue.text: Lightweight indisposed to interrupt aircraft strike

indicators.note: to interrupt means to break into, so these letters go inside

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian fighter aircraft
indisposed means unwell, ill
to ram is to strike hard

explanation.surface: A minor figure is too sick to break up an air attack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lightweight' looks like a person of little importance, but it is a unit of mass; 'to interrupt' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A milligram is a tiny unit of weight, a thousandth of a gram.

clue.text: Son thus stuffing poor writer's cushion

indicators.note: stuffing means filling, so these letters are packed inside

parts.note: a hack is a poor or mediocre writer
so means thus, in that way

explanation.surface: A boy stuffs a struggling author's cushion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stuffing' signals the filling, and 'poor writer' is the usual crossword hack.
explanation.definitionFit: A hassock is a firm kneeling cushion, as found in churches.

clue.text: One may move flats, being, responsible for properties

definitions.text: One may move flats, being, responsible for properties

parts.words: One may move flats, being, responsible for properties
parts.note: the clue suggests an estate agent shifting apartments, but flats are scenery panels and properties are theatre props

explanation.definitionFit: A theatre worker shifts scenery and looks after props backstage.

clue.text: Canadian town where courses are prepared with hesitation

parts.note: courses of a meal are cooked in a kitchen
er is a hesitant sound

explanation.surface: A Canadian place where meals are cooked haltingly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitchener is a city in Ontario, Canada.

clue.text: Conspicuous way foreigner is received

indicators.note: is received means is taken in, so it goes inside the other piece

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
an alien is a foreigner

explanation.surface: A notable street welcomes a visitor from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is received' means taken in, signalling the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Salient means prominent, standing out, striking.

clue.text: Difficulty about finally getting ready for the Russians

indicators.note: finally means at the end, so take the last letter of the word about

parts.note: ready is slang for cash, and the rouble is Russia's money

explanation.surface: A problem about at last being prepared for the Russians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ready' is British slang for money, as in 'readies'; 'getting' just links the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Trouble is a problem or difficulty.

clue.text: Fish out of old angler's trap

definitions.text: Fish out of old angler's trap

parts.words: Fish out of old angler's trap
parts.note: the whole clue describes a net trailed along to haul up fish, a trap anglers have long used

explanation.definitionFit: A dragnet is a net pulled along the water or seabed to catch fish.

clue.text: Spoke at length like pupils in the dark

definitions.meaning: to speak or write at length on a subject
eyes' pupils widen in low light

explanation.definitionFit: To dilate is to expand on a topic, and also to widen, as pupils do.

clue.text: Eddy identifies something given when trying out game

parts.note: one gives something a whirl when trying it out
pool is a cue game played on a table

explanation.surface: A man named Eddy sees what he tries out when playing a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eddy' looks like a man's name; it is a swirl of water.
explanation.definitionFit: An eddy is a swirling current of water, a small vortex.

clue.text: Evade obligation like Owain Glyndwr?

definitions.meaning: to fail to pay a debt or honour a promise
Owain Glyndwr was a medieval prince of Wales

explanation.definitionFit: To welsh on a bet is to dodge paying; Glyndwr was a native of Wales.

clue.text: Records a Hungarian composer's heard

indicators.note: heard means listened to, so the word is judged by sound

parts.note: Franz Liszt was a Hungarian composer

explanation.surface: A Hungarian composer's recordings are listened to.
explanation.walkthrough: LISZT'S sounds the same as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A list is a written record of items, so lists are records.

clue.text: Making this date is of great importance

definitions.text: Making this date is of great importance

parts.words: Making this date is of great importance
parts.note: the clue describes an idiom where something that makes a new era is hugely significant

explanation.definitionFit: Epoch-making describes an event so significant it begins a new era or period.

clue.text: He hunted 'immediately after imbibing port

indicators.note: imbibing means drinking in, so the port goes inside

parts.note: on means straight after, as in on arrival
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A man went hunting straight after downing some port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'port' tempts as wine but is a Brazilian harbour city; 'imbibing' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Orion was a giant huntsman, later a constellation.

clue.text: Short-tailed mammal crossing river is female

indicators.note: crossing means lying across, so the woman's name goes round the river letter

parts.note: Lois is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A small animal makes its way over a river, and it is a female.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crossing' puts LOIS round R.
explanation.definitionFit: A loris is a slow-moving nocturnal primate of south Asia with a stubby tail.

clue.text: Club celebrity entertains soldiers in army group

indicators.note: entertains means takes in as a guest, so the soldiers sit inside

parts.note: a bat is a club for hitting a ball
a lion is a celebrity, as in a literary lion
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve soldiers

explanation.surface: A famous figure at a club hosts troops from a military unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entertains' puts TA inside BATLION.
explanation.definitionFit: A battalion is a large army unit made up of several companies.

clue.text: Extremely antique methods ruined farm

indicators.note: ruined means wrecked, so these letters are broken up and rebuilt
extremely means at the extremes, the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: Very old-fashioned farming techniques wrecked a farm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extremely' takes A and E from 'antique'; 'ruined' shuffles them with METHODS.
explanation.definitionFit: A homestead is a house with its surrounding land and outbuildings, a farmstead.

clue.text: One who gives teacher endless work

parts.note: a don is a university teacher

indicators.note: endless means with its ends removed, so only the middle of the word remains

explanation.surface: A teacher's work never seems to end.
explanation.definitionFit: A donor is a giver, someone who donates.
